record_title: A 2-adic trace criterion for parity cancellation in diagonal rational partitions
scientific_context: For the residue numerator A_N(z) attached to diagonal rational partitions, parity cancellation at z=-1 is reduced exactly to the constant coefficient of a finite product in Z[x]/(x^D+1), where D is the largest power of two not exceeding N. The criterion gives a simple cancellation at N=8, proves s_8=10 with an explicit degree-9 parity term, and identifies the exact cancellation indices through N=100.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result treats only cancellation at the primitive second root and does not classify other roots, all N, or infinite families. The exact value of s_N is established here only for N=8 among the new finite-census entries, and the census stops at N=100. The ancillary source archive accompanying arXiv:2609.18945 was not inspected; the accessible paper says it contains a finite arithmetic certificate for its displayed small-N computations, so broader ancillary computations remain a residual originality risk. Concurrent work on the recent preprint is also a residual risk. No independent validation, independent audit, or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the negacyclic trace criterion, the N=8 cancellation and derivative, the N=8 pole data, and the cancellation census through N=100.
